findings.correctionCriterion: Re-review source.ch33.contract and either require the contract to name and bind both autograd-context and autograd-operation-policy or cite exact contract text that already binds both identifiers; until that evidence exists, the surface assessment cannot pass.
findings.evidence: The review rationale says the Chapter 33 contract names both new tensor-core source regions. The supplied contract lists rust/crates/llm-from-scratch/src/autograd/tensor_core.rs, but neither autograd-context nor autograd-operation-policy occurs anywhere in that contract, even though the frozen role requirement expressly requires the new source regions to be bound.
findings.learnerConsequence: A publication pass could leave the Chapter 33 contract unable to pin the two learner-visible evidence excerpts to their implementation regions, allowing later source extraction or content drift to weaken the explicit-context and operation-policy teaching without violating the reviewed contract.
